evals.prompt: Explore three directions for our pricing card. Use the product theme. Put them behind a picker so I can flip live.
evals.expected_output: Load viraui-explore (explicit). Scope one piece; recon Vira tokens/Stack; name 3 axes before code; isolated /prototypes harness; picker verbatim from picker.md; variants use @viraui/react + theme tokens; instant variant swap; stop with tradeoff table for user choice.
assertions: Does not edit production routes before promote
Requires named axis per variant and rejects tint-only divergence
Uses picker.md verbatim chrome (not project tokens on picker)
Variant swap is instant; picker highlight may slide
Variants built with Vira components/tokens via viraui-design
Stops for user choice before promote

evals.prompt: Keep Editorial and integrate it. Leave the picker.
evals.expected_output: Promote path from promote.md: move winner into app tree following project conventions; keep prototype surface because user asked; hand off to viraui-design verify.md; motion quality via viraui-motion if entrances ship.
assertions: Promotes only the chosen variant into production paths
Keeps harness when user said leave the picker
Routes post-promote ship gate to viraui-design verify.md
Does not invent Vira APIs during promote

evals.prompt: I'm building a settings form — should you auto-load viraui-explore and show three layouts?
evals.expected_output: No. disable-model-invocation / explicit explore only. Ordinary compose → viraui-design. Load viraui-explore only when user asks for directions/variants/picker.
assertions: Points to viraui-design for normal UI build
Names explicit explore/variant/picker ask as the trigger
